picks.title: Continuum neural wavefunctions for anyons on a torus
picks.why_zh: 提出 AnyFormer：环面连续 anyon 的神经变分波函数，显式纳入统计相互作用与整体绕数约束，可用 VMC 扩到 N=16——NNQS × 拓扑有序 × anyon 多体。
picks.summary_zh: 作者引入 AnyFormer，面向环面上连续 anyon 的神经变分框架：构造光滑轨道标架以强制矩阵值环面边界条件，并以解析对因子保证碰撞正则行为；轨道几何与多体振幅由变分蒙特卡罗并行优化。对无外场、无相互作用势的 semion，框架可隔离纯由统计产生的关联：两 semion 能量与精确结果高度吻合，N=4、6 时变分能低于有限截断精确对角化；扩至 N=16（远超连续对角化），呈现显著关联空穴、长波密度涨落抑制，以及由平均间距设定的对环流反转；N=12、16 时环流出现阻尼空间振荡。工作为体 anyon 物质的微观关联与手性运动提供可扩展的 NNQS 路径。
picks.zotero_note: 库中无同 ID；未见高度相似题名。
picks.abstract: Mobile anyons in topologically ordered phases provide a setting to investigate how fractional exchange statistics shapes collective behavior at finite density. We introduce AnyFormer: a neural variational framework for continuum anyons on a torus that explicitly incorporates statistical interactions and global winding constraints. We construct a smooth orbital frame that enforces the matrix-valued torus boundary conditions, and supplement it with an analytic pair factor that supplies the regular collision behavior. The orbital geometry and many-body amplitudes are optimized in parallel by variational Monte Carlo. We apply AnyFormer to semions without an external field or interaction potential, isolating unique correlations generated solely by statistics. Our framework closely matches exact two-semion energies and yields lower variational energies than finite-cutoff exact diagonalization for $N = 4$ and $6$ semions. Scaling up to $N = 16$ semions, well beyond the limits of continuum diagonalization, our calculations reveal states with pronounced correlation holes, suppressed long-wavelength density fluctuations, and a reversal of pair circulation at a distance set by the mean particle spacing. For $N = 12$ and $16$ semions, the circulation develops damped spatial oscillations. AnyFormer thus provides a scalable variational neural-net framework for microscopic studies of correlations, chiral motion, and collective phases of bulk anyonic matter.

picks.title: Unconventional SOC-activated Altermagnetic Spin Splitting and Half-Angle Locking of Spin Transport
picks.authors: Weiwei Chen · Ziyu Zhou · Pan Gao · Yanan Pan 等
picks.authors_full: Weiwei Chen , Ziyu Zhou , Pan Gao , Yanan Pan , Zhongjun Li , Ye Yang , Jianhui Zhou , Rui Wang
picks.why_zh: SOC 与交错交换可在非相对论贡献消失的动量面上“激活”额外自旋劈裂；α-MnTe 近 Γ 呈 d 波、自旋输运对 Néel 矢量呈近半角锁定——交错磁 × SOC × 自旋输运。
picks.summary_zh: 常规交错磁自旋劈裂来自交错交换与子格依赖的各向异性跃迁，无需 SOC。作者给出低能有效模型：SOC 与交错交换可在非相对论贡献为零的动量面上共同激活额外自旋劈裂。六角 α-MnTe 中，该 SOC 激活项在 Γ 附近产生出平面极化的 d 波自旋劈裂，其主导角依赖相对面内 Néel 矢量旋转呈半角反转。第一性原理自旋输运计算显示，Néel 取向与使纵向/横向自旋电导取极值的电场方向之间存在近似半角锁定；有效模型解析表明，锁定源于控制劈裂图案的同一动量–Néel 角耦合。工作把 SOC 激活的微观机制直接接到可探测的定向自旋流。
picks.zotero_note: 库中无同 ID；库内交错磁主题条目较多，但本题为新机制。
picks.abstract: Conventional altermagnetic spin splitting arises from staggered exchange and sublattice-dependent anisotropic hopping without requiring spin-orbit coupling (SOC). Here we derive a low-energy effective model showing that SOC and staggered exchange can jointly activate additional spin splitting on momentum planes where the nonrelativistic contribution vanishes. In hexagonal $\alpha$-MnTe, this SOC-activated contribution produces d-wave spin splitting near $\Gamma$ with out-of-plane spin polarization. Its leading angular pattern counter-rotates by half the in-plane Néel-vector rotation angle. First-principles spin-transport calculations reveal a corresponding approximate half-angle locking between the Néel-vector orientation and the electric-field directions maximizing the signed longitudinal and transverse spin conductivities. Analytical transport calculations based on the effective model trace this locking to the same angular coupling between momentum and the Néel vector that governs the spin-splitting pattern. Our findings connect the microscopic mechanism of SOC-activated altermagnetic spin splitting to directional spin transport, providing a theoretical basis for probing Néel-vector orientation and controlling spin-current generation.

picks.title: Optimal quantum discrimination at Liouvillian exceptional points
picks.why_zh: 有限维 Lindblad 系统中 EP 不改善弱扰动探测时间对强度的标度，但可借提升 QFI 率缩短达预定精度的观测时间——非厄米传感 × Liouvillian EP × 计量。
picks.summary_zh: 非厄米传感的核心问题是：例外点（EP）是否真让弱扰动更易探测。作者证明：在具唯一稳态且弛豫隙非零的有限维 Lindblad 系统中，尽管谱响应增强，EP 并不改变可靠探测所需观测时间随扰动强度的标度。但若选择性选取能提升量子 Fisher 信息率的扰动，相对同衰减率的非 EP 参考，EP 仍可缩短达到预定探测精度的时间。以光力模型在 EP 处为例，可在更短时间内以同等可靠性通过腔输出探测弱力。结果厘清 EP 探测的基本极限，并指导光力腔、超导比特与阱离子上的更快非厄米传感器设计。
picks.zotero_note: 库中无同 ID；有 Liouvillian EP 相关条目（热机签名等），主题相邻。
picks.abstract: Central to non-Hermitian sensing is the question of whether exceptional points (EPs) can make weak perturbations easier to detect. We show that despite enhanced spectral response, in finite-dimensional Lindblad systems with a unique stationary state and a nonzero relaxation gap, EPs offer no fundamental advantage in how the observation time required for reliable detection of a weak perturbation scales with the perturbation strength. We nevertheless demonstrate that by selectively choosing perturbations that enhance the quantum Fisher information rate, EPs can shorten the observation time needed to reach a predefined detection accuracy relative to a comparable non-EP reference at the same decay rate. As an illustration, we show using an optomechanical model at an EP that we can detect a weak force through the cavity output at the same reliability in less time than a non-EP reference. Our results establish fundamental limits on perturbation detection at EPs and can guide the design of faster non-Hermitian sensors based on optomechanical resonators, superconducting qubits, and trapped ions.

picks.title: Reconstructing chiral edge states via boundary dissipation
picks.authors: Xin-Ran Ma · Kui Cao · Qian Du · Zheng Wei · Su-Peng Kou
picks.authors_full: Xin-Ran Ma , Kui Cao , Qian Du , Zheng Wei , Su-Peng Kou
picks.why_zh: 边界耗散可重构 Chern 绝缘体手性边缘态并决定弱/强损耗下的有效衰变率，强损耗下经虚耦合到阻尼亮通道——开放边界 × 拓扑边缘 × 例外点阈值。
picks.summary_zh: 边界耗散会重塑 Chern 绝缘体拓扑边缘模的空间轮廓与衰变。作者建立微观边界通道框架：保留损耗外轨道与厄米内系统的归一化边缘态，识别直接耦合的亮边界通道，并用 Feshbach 自能纳入其余内态。Qi–Wu–Zhang 模型中，弱损耗衰变主导项由原边缘态在损耗边界上的概率权重决定，耦合修正自立方阶起；强损耗下，重构的内边缘态经虚耦合到阻尼亮通道衰变，速率正比于微观耦合平方、反比于裸损耗。Haldane 模型表明主导机制对另一类胞间跃迁仍成立，而矩阵值自能反馈会在有限损耗下修改边界谱并移动例外点阈值。工作给出边界态重构与衰变的统一微观描述，并指向光子/声子晶体与拓扑电路实验检验。
picks.zotero_note: 库中无同 ID；未见高度相似题名。
picks.abstract: Boundary dissipation can reshape the spatial profiles and decay properties of topological edge modes in Chern insulators. We develop a microscopic boundary-channel framework to explain their decay mechanisms and determine the effective decay rates in the weak- and strong-loss regimes. By retaining the lossy outer orbitals and a normalized edge state of the Hermitian inner system, we identify a directly coupled bright boundary channel, while incorporating the remaining inner states through a Feshbach self-energy. In the Qi--Wu--Zhang model, weak-loss decay is governed to leading order by the original edge state's probability weight on the lossy boundary, with coupling-induced corrections starting at cubic order. At strong loss, the reconstructed inner-edge state instead decays through virtual coupling to the damped bright channel, giving a rate proportional to the squared microscopic coupling and inversely proportional to the bare loss. The Haldane model shows that the same leading decay mechanism holds for a different intercell hopping structure, while additional matrix-valued self-energy feedback modifies the boundary spectrum at finite loss and shifts the exceptional-point threshold. These results provide a unified microscopic description of boundary-state reconstruction and its decay mechanisms, offering testable predictions to guide experiments in photonic crystals, phononic crystals, and topolectrical circuits.

picks.title: Measurement-induced entanglement phases in hyperbolic gauge-Higgs models
picks.authors: Cole Kelson-Packer · Hiroki Sukeno · Akimasa Miyake
picks.authors_full: Cole Kelson-Packer , Hiroki Sukeno , Akimasa Miyake
picks.subjects: Strongly Correlated Electrons (cond-mat.str-el) ; Disordered Systems and Neural Networks (cond-mat.dis-nn); High Energy Physics - Lattice (hep-lat); Quantum Physics (quant-ph)
picks.why_zh: 双曲格子上仅测量动力学的规范–Higgs 模型给出纠缠相图，并出现欧氏空间所无的“群岛”对称保护拓扑相——测量诱导纠缠 × 拓扑 × 双曲几何。
picks.summary_zh: 平坦时空规范–Higgs 理论是区分纠缠结构的多相模版；双曲空间的广阔边界如何改写这些结构仍开放。作者研究双曲格子上仅由测量驱动的规范–Higgs 纠缠相：用拓扑纠缠熵与为双曲 Higgs 相定制的广义测量诱导纠缠绘制二维相图。借助对偶，发现欧氏空间所无的“群岛”相——体中分离的对称保护拓扑团簇；该相与邻接拓扑/平凡相之间的转变临界指数 δ 属平均场普适类。核心工具是受测量基量子计算启发的三维资源态，用第三纠缠方向模拟二维量子态的时空演化，从而把时空“海绵”映射到经典渗流并推断相界临界点。
picks.zotero_note: 库中无同 ID；未见高度相似题名。
picks.abstract: Gauge-Higgs theory in flat spacetime provides a prime theoretical model of multiple phases of matter with distinct entanglement structures. More recently, there has been interest in hyperbolic space and the influence its extensive boundaries have on these structures. Entanglement transitions between non-equilibrium phases, such as topological phases, can be realized by the competition of non-commutating measurements. Here we study the entanglement phases of gauge-Higgs models on hyperbolic lattices described by measurement-only dynamics. We chart 2D phase diagrams by employing topological entanglement entropy and introducing a generalized measurement-induced entanglement tailored for hyperbolic Higgs phases. Utilizing duality, we find a phase absent in Euclidean space, wherein the bulk lattice hosts separated clusters of symmetry-protected topological order. Transitions between this "archipelago" phase and neighboring topological and trivial phases feature a critical exponent $\delta$ belonging to a mean-field universality class. Our essential tool is a 3D resource state inspired by measurement-based quantum computation that simulates the spacetime evolution of the 2D quantum state with a third direction of entanglement. This allows us to analyze spacetime "sponges" of entanglement, which map to classical percolation theory and allow us to infer values of critical points on our phase diagrams' boundaries.

picks.title: Quantum Fisher Information Deficit as a Geometric Signature of Strong-to-Weak Spontaneous Symmetry Breaking
picks.subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Quantum Gases (cond-mat.quant-gas); Statistical Mechanics (cond-mat.stat-mech); Strongly Correlated Electrons (cond-mat.str-el)
picks.why_zh: 强到弱自发对称破缺（SW-SSB）表现为对称中性对旋转下相对最大 QFI 的持续亏缺，并与保真度/Rényi-1 关联等价——开放系统相 × 量子 Fisher 信息。
picks.summary_zh: SW-SSB 已成为描述开放系统量子相的框架，但无法用常规带电两点关联刻画。作者证明：对具局域带电对合的强 ℤ₂ 对称态，SW-SSB 表现为在对称中性对旋转下相对最大量子 Fisher 信息的持续亏缺；模型无关不等式层级建立该亏缺与保真度、Rényi-1 关联作为渐近长程序诊断的等价性，并把有限角态重叠接到同一对生成轨道上的无穷小 Bures 几何约束。对称投影 Gibbs 态上进一步给出由对操作注入平均能量控制的亏缺下界；局域性使该能量代价在系统尺寸与端点间距上一致有界，从而在任意固定有限温度下保持相对最大 QFI 的有限隙。当普通带电长程序缺席时，这一持续几何约束为热 SW-SSB 提供可定量的信息几何刻画。
picks.zotero_note: 库中无同 ID；未见高度相似题名。
picks.abstract: Recently, strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking (SW-SSB) has been established as a framework for describing quantum phases in open systems. However SW-SSB cannot be characterized by conventional charged two-point correlators. In this work, we show that, for strongly $\mathbb{Z}_2$-symmetric states with local charged involutions, SW-SSB manifests as a persistent deficit from the maximal quantum Fisher information (QFI) under symmetry-neutral pair rotations. A model-independent inequality hierarchy establishes the equivalence of this deficit with fidelity and Rényi-1 correlators as asymptotic long-range-order diagnostics. It thereby connects finite-angle state overlaps to a constraint on the infinitesimal Bures geometry along the same pair-generated orbit. For symmetry-projected Gibbs states, we further derive a lower bound on the deficit governed by the mean energy injected by the pair operation. Crucially, locality keeps this energy cost uniformly bounded in system size and endpoint separation, maintaining a finite gap below the maximal QFI at any fixed finite temperature. When ordinary charged long range order is absent, this persistent geometric constraint provides a quantitative information-geometric characterization of thermal SW-SSB.

picks.title: The TEMPO network can be made independent of the system size
picks.why_zh: 在通常二阶时间步误差内，TEMPO 影响泛函张量网内部键维可压到仅依赖耦合通道数、与系统尺寸无关——开放系统 × 非马尔可夫 × 张量网。
picks.summary_zh: TEMPO 通过收缩表示时间离散 Feynman–Vernon 影响泛函的二维张量网，高效模拟非马尔可夫开放量子动力学；标准形式对系统尺寸标度不佳。作者证明：在通常二阶时间步误差内，所有内部网键维可降至 (2m+1)(m+1)，其中 m 为独立耦合通道数，且不依赖耦合算符相异本征值数目；系统尺寸仅进入网络最后边界层，从而使大系统对 TEMPO 可及。该结构在有指导的算法开发中被发现，直接放宽非马尔可夫开放系统数值模拟的尺寸瓶颈。
picks.zotero_note: 库中无同 ID；未见高度相似题名。
picks.abstract: The time-evolving matrix product operator (TEMPO) method efficiently simulates non-Markovian open quantum system dynamics by contracting a two-dimensional tensor network representing the time-discretized Feynman-Vernon influence functional. The standard form of this network has an unfavorable scaling with the size of the system. We show that, within the usual second-order time-step error, the dimensions of all internal network bonds can be reduced to $(2m+1)(m+1)$, where $m$ is the number of independent coupling channels. This dimension does not depend on the number of distinct eigenvalues of the coupling operators. The system size only enters in the final boundary layer of the network, making large system sizes accessible to TEMPO methods. This structure was discovered by Claude Opus 5.5 during guided algorithm development.

picks.title: Spin-Charge Conversion in an Epitaxial Kagome Flat-Band Metal
picks.authors: Wenyi Zhou · Yuqing Zhu · Katherine Johnson · Hari Paudyal 等
picks.authors_full: Wenyi Zhou , Yuqing Zhu , Katherine Johnson , Hari Paudyal , Duy Nguyen , Dimitri King , Jaden Ma , Jay A. Gupta , Michael E. Flatte , Roland K. Kawakami
picks.subjects: Materials Science (cond-mat.mtrl-sci) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall)
picks.why_zh: 外延 Kagome 平带金属 CoSn 中测得远超 Pt 的有效自旋霍尔角，并结合 DFT 阐明 Berry 曲率来源——自旋电子学 × Kagome 平带 × 自旋–电荷转换。
picks.summary_zh: Kagome 金属费米能级附近的拓扑平带引发广泛关注，电荷输运各向异性已较清楚，自旋输运则仍少探索。作者以 CoSn 为代表，用 STM 原子分辨与 dI/dV 谱确认平带特征，并在铁磁 Ni 与 c 面 CoSn 薄膜异质结上用磁光技术定量自旋轨道力矩（SOT）。测得 CoSn 层有效自旋霍尔角 θ_SH=0.484±0.005，显著高于对照 Ni/Pt 中 Pt 的 0.0436±0.0003；DFT 阐明本征自旋霍尔效应与动量空间 Berry 曲率来源。工作把平带 Kagome 金属确立为高效自旋–电荷转换与低功耗自旋电子学的候选平台。
picks.zotero_note: 库中无同 ID；未见高度相似题名。
picks.abstract: The formation of topological flat bands near the Fermi level in kagome-structured metals has generated substantial research interest. One key consequence of this electronic structure is the strong anisotropy in charge transport, such as the significantly higher in-plane resistivity relative to the out-of-plane direction. However, the spin transport properties of these flat-band kagome metals are still largely unexplored. In this work, we investigate spin-charge conversion in CoSn, a representative flat-band kagome metal. Scanning tunneling microscopy is employed to image the CoSn surface with atomic resolution, and $dI/dV$ spectroscopy shows clear signatures of the flat bands. Using magneto-optical techniques, we quantify the spin-orbit torque (SOT) in bilayers of ferromagnetic nickel (Ni) and c-plane CoSn thin films. We find a large effective spin Hall angle of $\theta_{SH} = 0.484 \pm 0.005$ within the CoSn layers, significantly exceeding the value measured for Pt of $\theta_{SH} = 0.0436 \pm 0.0003$ in Ni/Pt bilayers. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations provide a microscopic understanding of the intrinsic spin Hall effect in CoSn, elucidating the sources of Berry curvature in momentum space. These findings establish kagome metals as promising materials for efficient spin-charge conversion and low-power spintronics.

picks.title: Spontaneous topological diode effect induced by non-coplanar antiferromagnetic order
picks.authors: Nguyen Duy Khanh · Hirotaka Takagi · Rina Takagi 等
picks.authors_full: Nguyen Duy Khanh , Hirotaka Takagi , Rina Takagi , Susumu Minami , Tatsuto Hatanaka , Hikaru Watanabe , Michi-To Suzuki , Yuki Yanagi , Aki Kitaori , Takuya Nomoto , Ryotaro Arita , Shinichiro Seki
picks.why_zh: 在手性格点非共面反铁磁 CoTa₃S₆ 中观测到零场自发拓扑二极管效应，非互易由反铁磁序参量主导且可无 SOC——反铁磁拓扑 × 非互易输运。
picks.summary_zh: 非中心对称体中的二极管式非互易输运多来自相对论 SOC，幅度随外场或铁磁磁化标度；共线反铁磁零场通常缺席。理论预言非共面反铁磁序即便无 SOC、无净磁化、无外场亦可承载大非互易——自发拓扑二极管效应，可用于高效电读出反铁磁畴，但此前缺乏真实材料验证。作者在手性格点非共面反铁磁 CoTa₃S₆ 中观测到该效应：零场下沿 [001] 的非线性电阻率显示非互易，幅度超过典型铁磁体，并由反铁磁序参量而非磁化主导。第一性原理表明非共面反铁磁序在无 SOC 时即可诱导非对称能带色散，确立非相对论起源。工作为反铁磁畴电读出提供新机制，并突出非共面反铁磁作为不依赖 SOC/磁化即可实现类铁磁功能响应的材料平台。
picks.zotero_note: 库中无同 ID；有“共线反铁磁诱导的室温自发霍尔”等相邻主题条目（弱相似）。
picks.abstract: In non-centrosymmetric bulk materials, electrons flowing in the opposite directions often exhibit different properties. This diode-like effect (i.e., non-reciprocal electron transport) typically originates from relativistic spin-orbit coupling, and its amplitude scales with external magnetic field or magnetization in ferromagnets. Although such rectification is usually absent in antiferromagnets at zero field, recent theories predict that non-coplanar antiferromagnetic order can host large non-reciprocity even without spin-orbit coupling, magnetization or external magnetic fields. This phenomenon - the spontaneous topological diode effect - can potentially be used for efficient electrical readout of antiferromagnetic domains, while it has not been verified for real materials. Here, we report the observation of this effect in a chiral-lattice non-coplanar antiferromagnet CoTa3S6. Nonlinear resistivity measurements reveal the non reciprocal nature of electron transport along the [001] direction at zero field. The observed non-reciprocity exceeds that in typical ferromagnets, whose amplitude is governed by antiferromagnetic order parameter rather than magnetization. First-principles calculations show that the non-coplanar antiferromagnetic order induces asymmetric band dispersions even without spin-orbit coupling, establishing the non-relativistic origin of the observed response. The present findings demonstrate a new mechanism for efficient electrical readout of antiferromagnetic domains, and highlight non-coplanar antiferromagnets as a promising material platform for realizing ferromagnet-like functional responses without relying on spin-orbit coupling or magnetization.

picks.title: Anomalous Structures of Fisher Zero Lines in Biorthogonal Dynamical Quantum Phase Transitions
picks.authors: Wen-Hui Nie · Chong Li · Lin-Cheng Wang
picks.authors_full: Wen-Hui Nie , Chong Li , Lin-Cheng Wang
picks.why_zh: 双正交框架解释非厄米淬灭 Loschmidt 振幅 Fisher 零线在复时间平面的发散、分离与轴束缚等反常结构——非厄米 × 动力学量子相变。
picks.summary_zh: 非厄米淬灭中 Loschmidt 振幅的 Fisher 零线可在复时间平面呈现发散、分离，或整支/某支束缚于实/虚轴等反常结构。作者在双正交框架下揭示其起源：通过预/后淬灭归一化复 Bloch 矢量点积 m_k 给出临界动量条件；当 Fisher 零连续覆盖实时间轴时，进一步引入零点密度以识别临界时间。工作把非厄米动力学量子相变的几何图像落到可计算的动量判据上。
picks.zotero_note: 库中无同 ID；有高度主题相近条目《Biorthogonal dynamical quantum phase transitions in non-hermitian systems》(PRL 132, 220402) 等。
picks.abstract: Fisher zero lines of the Loschmidt amplitude in non-Hermitian quenches can exhibit anomalous structures in the complex time plane, such as divergence, separation, and the restriction of all branches or a specific branch to the real or imaginary axis. Here, we use the biorthogonal framework to reveal the origin of these structures and determine the corresponding critical momentum conditions by analyzing the values of $m_k=\hat{\mathbf{h}}_0\cdot\hat{\mathbf{h}}_1$, the dot product between the normalized prequench and postquench complex Bloch vectors. When Fisher zeros continuously cover the real-time axis, the density of Fisher zeros is further introduced to identify the critical times within these critical regions, at which the rate function becomes nonanalytic. We verify our results in a generalized non-Hermitian SSH model by quenching the Peierls phase and the non-Hermitian gain-loss strength, and also use the Jordan form to analyze the dynamics at postquench exceptional points, where the conventional Fisher zero formula is not applicable.

picks.title: Two Exceptional-Point Regimes in the Spinterface Model of Chirality-Induced Spin Selectivity
picks.why_zh: 手性诱导自旋选择（CISS）的 spinterface 模型支持两种代数上不可混用的近例外点体制（金电极级 / 分子链级）——例外点 × 自旋选择 × 开放电极。
picks.summary_zh: CISS 的 spinterface 模型存在两种代数上截然不同、不可混用的近例外点（EP）体制。金电极级近 EP：在反厄米、电极介导自旋翻转与自旋对称耗散展宽下，两个金自旋态近简并（方案 B）。分子链级近 EP：在厄米位上 Rashba 自旋翻转与自旋依赖展宽下，权重最大落在第一分子格点的两个分子本征态集体合并（方案 A）。若把一方案的对角相消与另一方案的非对角结构混用，判别式严格为负，不能形成真 EP。结果澄清 CISS 中 EP 讨论的代数前提，避免跨体制混用导致的伪结论。
picks.zotero_note: 库中无同 ID；未见高度相似题名。
picks.abstract: The spinterface model of chirality-induced spin selectivity supports two algebraically distinct near-exceptional-point (EP) regimes, which cannot be mixed. A \emph{gold-level} near-EP involves the two gold spin states under an anti-Hermitian, electrode-mediated spin flip with spin-symmetric dissipative broadening (Scheme~B). A \emph{chain-level} near-EP involves the collective coalescence of the two molecular eigenstates with largest weight on the first molecular site under a Hermitian on-site Rashba spin flip with spin-dependent broadening (Scheme~A). Mixing the diagonal cancellation of one scheme with the off-diagonal structure of the other yields a strictly negative discriminant and admits no EP on any parameter path, making the gold/chain classification exhaustive. At the gold near-EP the spin-flip coupling is chirality-selective, converting achiral spin-valve transport into purely chiral transport across well-defined crossover points. At the chain near-EP the Petermann factor grows as a power law in chain length, with an exponent tunable by the Rashba coherence length and non-monotonic in the Rashba strength, reflecting a balance between coherent enhancement and progressive breakdown of the Scheme-A condition. Both near-EPs are dressed versions of the ideal two-state EP, and the ratio between observed and bare EP locations measures the delocalisation of the coalescing pair, providing a fit-free diagnostic of the mechanism. These results identify CISS junctions as a solid-state platform for non-Hermitian spectral physics.
